about.heroTitle:
I Got Tired of Paying
for Software I Barely Used.
So I Built Something Better.
about.missionP1: I run two businesses — an AI operations company and a multi-city European tour operator. Both used to run on the usual SaaS stack: separate CRM, project management, analytics, email tools, booking systems. Over a dozen subscriptions totaling $1,200/month.
about.missionP2: In 2025 I started replacing them. Not with more SaaS — with AI-operated tools running on a single server I own. Custom CRM. Automated reporting. AI agents that handle lead follow-ups, task routing, and cross-platform orchestration. The entire stack now costs $210/month.
about.missionP3: That's what I build for clients. Not generic 'AI consulting' — the exact same infrastructure I run my own businesses on. If it breaks, it breaks for me first.
about.value1Text: Every system we deliver is something we run ourselves first. Our CRM, our automations, our reporting — all built on the same architecture we install for clients.
about.value2Text: We think in monthly cost, time saved, and tasks eliminated — not features shipped. The goal is fewer tools, fewer dashboards, fewer things to manage.
about.value3Text: Everything runs on servers you own. No vendor lock-in, no platform risk, no surprise pricing changes. You keep your data and your systems.

contact.heroDescription: Most companies we audit are wasting $1K–$5K/month on SaaS tools they only use 10–20% of. Let's find out what yours looks like — and what it could look like instead.
contact.formSubtitle: Describe your current stack and what's not working. We'll get back within one business day with an honest assessment.
contact.formMessagePlaceholder: Which tools do you use? What workflows feel manual or broken? What would you want automated?
contact.formThankYouSub: We'll review your stack and get back to you within one business day.
contact.erikQuote: I'll personally review your stack and tell you what's worth replacing, what's worth keeping, and what the transition looks like.
contact.whyText1: We respond to every inquiry within one business day.
contact.whyText2: Your audit is done by someone who runs the same systems — not a sales team.
contact.whyText3: Honest assessment of what's replaceable in your stack. No pitch deck.
contact.faq1Q: How does the AI Operations Audit work?
contact.faq1A: In a 30-minute call, we review your current SaaS stack, identify what's replaceable, and outline what an AI Operations System would look like for your business. No obligations.
contact.faq2A: A basic SaaS replacement (CRM, task management) takes 4–6 weeks. A full AI Operations System with automations and integrations takes 8–12 weeks.
contact.faq3A: Projects start at €5,000 for targeted SaaS replacement. Full AI Operations Systems typically range from €15,000–€40,000 depending on complexity.
contact.faq4Q: What happens to my data during migration?
contact.faq4A: Everything migrates to infrastructure you own — your server, your database. We handle the full migration and provide documentation so your team can maintain it.
